description: eslint-plugin-n 18.4.1 n/exports-style (default "module.exports", no batch assign): every reference to the global `exports` (Node's CommonJS-scope binding; a local `exports` shadows it). No sourceType is pinned, so each file keeps its own module system (.cjs/.cts CommonJS; .mjs/.mts/.tsx an ES module; .js/.jsx/.ts by the nearest package.json's type, Node's syntax detection where that package.json sets no valid type, and an ES module where there is no package.json). As eslint-plugin-n's own configs (flat/mixed-esm-and-cjs picks per file), a CommonJS file has require, module, exports, __dirname and __filename (flat/recommended-script) and an ES module none of them (flat/recommended-module turns them off). So only a CommonJS file has the global `exports`; an ES module's references are not reported.
